name: MkDocs
description: MkDocs is a fast, simple static site generator geared toward building project documentation, using Markdown source files and a single YAML configuration file.
best_for: Developers and project maintainers who want to write documentation in plain Markdown and generate a professional static site without a heavyweight build system.
features: Documentation written in Markdown and configured via a single YAML file
Built-in themes (mkdocs and readthedocs) plus a wide range of third-party themes
Plugin system for extending and customizing site generation
Markdown extensions to modify and enhance default Markdown behavior
Live-reloading development server for real-time preview while writing
Fully static HTML output that requires no server-side processing
Deployable anywhere, including GitHub Pages and Amazon S3

alternatives.name: Docusaurus
alternatives.description: An open source static site generator for building documentation websites with Markdown/MDX and React.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want React-based theming and built-in versioning/localization.

alternatives.name: Read the Docs
alternatives.description: A documentation building and hosting platform that builds versioned docs from Git and previews changes on pull requests.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want hosting and build automation handled for them, including for MkDocs sites.

pricing.starting_price: Free and open source under the BSD license

tiers.name: MkDocs
tiers.notes: Open-source static site generator; no MkDocs license fee.

cons: MkDocs generates static documentation but does not provide a managed hosting, build, access-control, analytics, or support service by itself; teams must supply those pieces separately.
Operational responsibilities such as deployment, hosting, CI integration, backups, and production availability remain with the team or its chosen hosting provider.
